title: Chapter 1059
text:
Just as the Arcane Church was about to retreat, Sierron, who was fighting with the Mechanical Deity, also received suggestions from others.

"Your Excellency Sierron, let's retreat. The situation will only get worse for us. There's no point in fighting with Black Star who's burning his potential here," Hades said urgently in the group chat.

"That's right. Although more than ten people were forced to retreat by Black Star alone, this is the best plan for now. Since he paid such a huge price, it's best if we don't fight with him anymore," Mornisa agreed.

Sierron clashed with the Mechanical Deity for a while before retreating. His expression was not too good.

Although he was unwilling to admit it, Black Star's strength was on par with his, and they could not do anything to each other. The consumption of the Mechanical Deity was terrifying, just like Ultraman's Three Minutes. Normal Mechanics would not be able to maintain it for long, but Black Star's recovery ability was amazing, and he could maintain it for a long time. This meant that even if the two of them were able to determine a winner, it would take a very long time.

Now that Ethereal seemed to have the intention of retreating, if they continued to fight with Black Star, all the pressure would be transferred to Radiance.

Sierron himself was not afraid, but he could not fight on multiple fronts like Mechanics, so he was at a disadvantage in terms of class.

Radiance did not plan to fight Black Star head-on from the start. Since the plan to capture Hella alive had failed, it would be pointless to continue fighting. Sierron made a prompt decision and said with a deep voice, "Retreat.

"Retreat and let the Multi-Dimensional Sky Opening Transportation Device warm up."

Then, Sierron stopped fighting with the Mechanical Deity and turned around to open a path. His Pugilist Wave shot out again and again, creating an empty space among the thousands of soldiers.

On the other side, while leading his teammates to escape, Kasuyi stopped acting. Psychic energy surged, and all the mechanical troops blocking the way were swept to the side.

The escape routes of the two groups were different. Radiance brought the fleet, and the Multi-Dimensional Sky Opening Transportation Device was their escape route. Ethereal, on the other hand, had very few troops. Only Beyond Grade A Supers were required to escape alone. As long as they left the area of the space stabilizing device, they could escape using teleportation scrolls.

Han Xiao immediately noticed the change in the target of the battle. Both sides were wading through the black tide of the Mech Legion, trying to break through in two different directions.

Radiance and Ethereal could not wait for the other party to hold back Black Star, so naturally, they would not continue to help the other party. Ethereal, on the other hand, would not run over to Radiance's side, or else it would be like jumping out of a tiger's den into a wolf's lair.

"… Our alliance has been broken."

Han Xiao's eyes flashed, and he controlled the Mechanical Deity to chase after Radiance's troops.

The Mech Legion was divided into two groups under his command, while the Apostle Weapons and the Mysterious Energy Host abandoned the Beyond Grade A Ethereal and focused on the Radiance.

It was more effective to gather forces to deal with one group. The reason he targeted Radiance was because he owed Kasuyi a favor, and the other reason was that it was too difficult to chase after Ethereal.

Once Kasuyi stopped acting, his ability to contain Ethereal's troops would be unparalleled. If he chased after Ethereal's troops at this time, it would be basically impossible for him to stop any of them. Kasuyi was just a doppelganger, so he could completely sacrifice himself to bring up the rear. His Psychokinesis was enough to stop all of his troops for a period of time.

In comparison, Sierron was just a Pugilist with limited AOE abilities. He was not good at protecting his teammates, and he was still in his main body. He could not miss out on Radiance's train. With all these factors added together, Radiance was naturally easier to deal with.

Once he decided on his target, Han Xiao did not hesitate to lock onto a Beyond Grade A Radiance and threw out a skill.

[Virtual Paramount]!

'Lone Ranger' Jackornitz was using all kinds of mechanical weapons to fight with the Apostle Weapons. Suddenly, his body froze. His soul was trapped in the Virtual World by Han Xiao, and he lost control of his body.

In such a dangerous situation, even the slightest bit of carelessness could be fatal, let alone being controlled for more than ten seconds.

As a Mechanical Pugilist, his physical defense was not as strong as a Pugilist, and he did not have True Damage Immunity talents. The surrounding Mech Army and Apostle Weapons swarmed toward him, causing Jackornitz's health to drop like a falling cliff.

Han Xiao chose him because he was fragile enough. The Meeting of the Gods allowed him to obtain information on most Beyond Grade A abilities.

Swoosh!

Without saying anything, the Mechanical Deity stretched its arm across the sky, grabbed Jackornitz, and sucked him into its body.

When Jackornitz got rid of the control of Virtual Paramount, his consciousness returned to his body. He immediately felt a strong sense of weakness, leaving him with a heavily injured body that was controlled by the traps that were everywhere in the Mechanical Deity.

"How is this possible …"

Jackornitz could not help but be shocked. He could not believe that he had lost so quickly.

Even when facing the troops of the Mecha Empire, he could last longer. In the past, he only knew that Black Star was tanky. How was his damage so high?

Han Xiao was not surprised. His Mech Army's damage output was not low at all.

[Legendary Battle Technique] was indeed a Molding Talent. As long as his mechanical army broke through the shield of a Beyond Grade A Super without True Damage Resistance and focused fire on the main body, even a Beyond Grade A Super would not be able to withstand such terrifying HP loss.

At this time, Jackornitz was transported to Han Xiao's main body by the nanoparticles in the Mechanical Deity. Han Xiao turned around and looked at him.

"Once you're in my body, you can't run. If you don't want to suffer, don't resist."

As soon as he said that, countless cannons extended from the inner walls of the Mechanical Deity and aimed at Jackornitz.

Under the helmet of the mechanical suit, Jackornitz could not help but smile bitterly.

Fine, I can't beat Black Star in the first place, and now he's even risking his life. A wise man knows better than to fight when the odds are against him.

At the same time, the people of Radiance outside were shocked and furious. They had clearly seen the entire process. Black Star had easily captured Jackornitz like a chicken.

"Your Excellency Sierron, this …" Womre could not help but say.

"Don't worry about him. He can't be saved." Sierron's expression was gloomy.

Unlike Kasuyi, he had come with his main body and did not have the capital to act recklessly. If he stayed behind and tried to save his teammates, he would not be able to make it in time for Radiance's teleportation. When the dynasty's reinforcements arrived, he would probably die here.

No matter how angry he was, Sierron could only hold it in.

…

At the same time, the Arcane Church members who had broken through from another direction also saw the Federation of Light's casualties and could not help but feel refreshed.

Sagman and the others were originally a little depressed that Tolaen had been captured. Now that Radiance was also unlucky, they immediately felt better.

Just as a certain famous person with the surname Lu said, when one was unlucky, the best consolation was not that others pitied them but that others were as unlucky as them. That was what Ethereal was thinking now.

This time, Kasuyi's eyes flashed. After thinking for a while, he suddenly stopped and said, "You guys go first. I'll stay behind to do something."

"What are you going to do?" Sagman was curious.

Kasuyi turned to look in the direction of Radiance and smiled. "Radiance still hasn't given up on the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter. It's a good chance to teach them a lesson and get back some interest."

Everyone immediately understood. Only Kasuyi's avatar would be able to do something like this.

What Kasuyi was thinking was to restrain the people of Radiance and help Black Star capture more Beyond Grade As from Radiance.

He hoped that Black Star would capture some captives to vent his anger in exchange for compensation from a Universal Civilization. Of course, it would be best if he did not sell out his teammates. Radiance was the best replacement.

Furthermore, this reason was very reasonable. If he became an actor, Ethereal would even praise him for doing a good job. Eliminating the loss caused by the failure of the mission and the capture of his teammates was like killing two birds with one stone.

With that in mind, Kasuyi left Sagman and the others and charged toward Radiance's people without hesitation. At the same time, he opened a private chat window with Han Xiao.

"Do you still remember the deal I mentioned to you earlier? Work together?"

Han Xiao was chasing after the federation's people. When he saw Kasuyi rushing toward this battlefield, he originally planned to stop him, but when he heard this, even he could not help but be speechless. Thousands of words of disdain appeared in his stomach, but they all merged into one sentence.

I'm really thanking you on behalf of Radiance!

With his participation in the battle, the situation immediately changed. The members of Federation were swept by Kasuyi's psychic energy and suffered a strong mental impact. Their bodies trembled violently, and a large number of openings appeared. The Mech Legion took advantage of this and made their opponents fall into an even tighter encirclement. Their breakout speed suddenly slowed down.

Seeing this, Sierron was furious.

"Kasuyi!"

When I invited you to work together to deal with Black Star, didn't you say you were out of MP?

You f * cking played me!

He did not expect the Arcane Church to be so shameless and come over to help Black Star deal with them.

"Don't look at me like that." Kasuyi's tone was indifferent. "During the battle on Planet Lighthouse, you also stabbed us in the back. The situation then is very similar to now. I'm just doing the same thing as you."

During the battle on Planet Lighthouse, because of Radiance, Ethereal was forced into a passive position. Radiance even killed a Beyond Grade A and stole the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter.

As the saying goes, don't look at the fun today, be careful of the list in the future, so Kasuyi had no psychological burden. At this time, it was impolite not to reciprocate.

Sierron's face was green. He roared and charged back. Highly condensed Pugilist flames appeared around his body and opened up an empty area. The peak Beyond Grade A Pugilist's Single Blade Dash ability was fully unleashed, sweeping everything in its path like a hot knife through butter. No mechanical army could stop him.

He knocked away countless mechanical soldiers along the way and charged toward Crystal Soul. He grabbed it and left, not caring about the rest of his teammates.

Sierron knew that once Kasuyi interfered, Radiance would definitely have to leave many people behind. He could only try his best to limit his losses.

Crystal Soul was small and a crystal life form. Furthermore, it had a Universal Treasure, so it had the highest priority. Sierron took Crystal Soul, who was the closest to him, and fled. As for the rest, he could not do anything.

Mornisa saw this and stopped running. She ordered her mechanical army to cover their retreat. Although they were forced to retreat, they still managed to slow down the pursuit of Han Xiao's Mech Legion.

As a result, the ones under the most pressure were Hades and Womre, who were lagging behind.

"Damn it …"

Blood spurted out of Hades's orifices. He was also a Psychic, but he could not fight back at all in front of Kasuyi. He was dizzy and weak, unable to keep calm. His face was filled with unwillingness.

At this time, the palm of the Mechanical Deity suddenly came down. Hades looked up in a daze, and his vision was completely covered by this steel dome.

Hades had not been a Beyond Grade A for long, so he was not very clear about the division of Beyond Grade A. Seeing this, he only had one thought left in his mind.

This was the true power of the universe!

The next moment, the mechanical palm came down. His vision turned black, and he lost consciousness instantly.

"The third one."

Han Xiao sucked Hades, who had lost consciousness, into the Mechanical Deity and turned to look at 'Energy Soul' Womre.

At this time, all the Apostle Weapons were attacking Womre alone.

This Pugilist's style was different from Sierron's and Gorutan's. His every move was filled with the aura of a grandmaster. It did not look fierce, but rather smooth and natural, as if it contained some kind of natural law. Compared to close combat, he seemed to be more proficient in mid-range Pugilist wave attacks. His Pugilist aura was endless, as if it would never run out.

The light blue aura was like a spinning shield, constantly deflecting the attacks of the Apostle Weapons. His fists were neither fast nor slow, shooting out an energy wave with every punch. Even though Womre was in a passive position, he did not seem to be in a bad state. However, there was no way for him to turn the tables. He could only be considered to be at death's door. Defeat was only a matter of time.

Seeing that Sierron and Crystal Soul were running further and further away, and that he was surrounded with no way out, Womre decided not to run anymore and stayed behind with Mornisa.

The Mechanical Deity waved its arms and tore apart a large number of enemy mechanical troops, as well as the unmanned fleet sent by Radiance, quickly destroying Mornisa's fragile Lord's Avatar.

Womre was in a one-on-one situation. Not long after, he was also captured alive by the Apostle Weapons, the Mysterious Energy Host, and Hella.

However, it was not for nothing that they stayed behind. Sierron and Crystal Soul had already escaped into the Radiant Federation's fleet. The Multi-Dimensional Sky Opening Transportation Device had already been warmed up.

The two large mechanical rings that were perpendicular to each other spun rapidly, faster and faster, turning into a blur. The tracks of the two rings formed a sphere, surrounding the area where the fleet was.

Sierron finally turned around and glared at Kasuyi before turning back to Han Xiao. He was so angry that his teeth were itching.

"Black Star, just you wait. Radiance won't let you off so easily after capturing our people!"

Hum!

The speed of the two rings suddenly stopped. The fleet within the sphere had already disappeared, breaking through the restrictions of the space stabilizing device and being teleported away. Only the unmanned fleet and the mechanical army were left.

The next moment, the Multi-Dimensional Sky Opening Transportation Device self-destructed and exploded.

With the people of Radiance gone, the scene became much quieter.

"Only two of Radiance escaped."

Han Xiao stopped. His eyes flickered as he looked in another direction. The few Beyond Grade As from Ethereal had already escaped far away.

At this time, Kasuyi's voice sounded in his mind.

"What's wrong? You captured three Beyond Grade As from Radiance and one from Ethereal. Are you still not satisfied?"

Hearing this, Han Xiao looked at Kasuyi, only to see the latter's calm face.

"Thank you." Han Xiao calmed himself down, deactivated the Mechanical Deity, and nodded at Kasuyi.

Without Kasuyi's help, he would have been able to capture three people at most. Now that he had captured four Beyond Grade As and destroyed two Mechanic avatars, it was equivalent to killing half of the enemies.

The main reason was that he had used the Character Summon Card to increase his strength. Other than that, Hella's help and the Spacetime Amber were also important factors. This was especially so for the Spacetime Amber. The shield wall formed by the Spacetime Amber blocked a lot of long-range attacks, so he did not have to worry about defending or taking hits. This meant that he had freed up a lot of energy to attack. At the same time, he had also relied on the Spacetime Amber to seal the Beyond Grade As. Its tactical role was extremely important, and at least twenty to thirty percent of the credit belonged to it.

It had to be said that Ravenlaude's treasure in his previous life was really useful.

Although two of the four Beyond Grade As were newbies and the other two were not very strong, Beyond Grade As were still Beyond Grade As, and they all had Molding Talents. It all depended on whether Fu Ding could make good use of them this time.

Various thoughts flashed through his mind. Seeing that Kasuyi had been staring at him, Han Xiao simply recalled the Mech Legion that was chasing the Ethereal people.

At this time, the space stabilizing device had already disappeared. He directly opened the secondary dimensional army box and stuffed the intact mechanical army inside. Then, he used the (Dimension Factory) to collect all the parts and repair them.

While doing this, Han Xiao casually asked, "What are you going to do next? Continue to escort the Ethereal people away?"

"Hmm, when they use the teleportation scroll to reach a safe place, I'll deactivate my avatars. You won't chase after them anymore, right?"

Kasuyi smiled faintly and sighed in his heart.

How long had it been since the universe had such a strong battle record?

When the results of this battle spread out, who knew how big of a commotion it would cause?

"Since I've promised you, I won't go back on my words … By the way, let me show you something."

Han Xiao waved his hand and called Hella over in front of Kasuyi.

"Are you okay?" Hella stared at Han Xiao's face, not even bothering to look at Kasuyi.

Although Kasuyi had come over to help just now, in her opinion, the Ethereal people were still enemies. Naturally, she did not know that this was a movie king.

"I'm fine." Han Xiao shook his head and said seriously, "Ames was attacked in Black Star Palace. Go back and help her. Also, swap Yin Ying over."

Hella was stunned. "What do you mean? How do I go back and help her? "

"I have a new technology that can teleport you back."

Han Xiao's body flashed, and the King left his body and automatically passed through Hella's body. However, it was connected to Han Xiao's Mechanical Force.

After many private tests, Han Xiao knew the operating mechanism of the King like the back of his hand. The King itself was a Mechanic exclusive equipment, and the teleportation function of the Throne was targeted at the user inside the mechanical suit. However, if it was through the Quantum Infinite Distance Transmission channel and maintained a Mechanical Force connection with the King, even if there was someone else in the mechanical suit, Han Xiao would still be able to activate this function and teleport the wearer of the mechanical suit to a fixed location.

At this time, the Throne was about to arrive at Black Star Palace, and he could return to the base as soon as he teleported back.

Han Xiao turned around and saw that Kasuyi was watching this scene with interest, so he deliberately activated the space stabilization device and covered the area again.

Then, Han Xiao snapped his fingers, and the King disappeared right in front of Kasuyi's eyes.

Kasuyi's expression suddenly changed, and he was surprised. "This is … Multi-Dimensional Sky Opening Teleportation? When did you learn Radiance's technology? "

"It's not Multi-Dimensional Sky Opening. This is another technology, but the effect is about the same. It can break through the blockade of space stabilization anchors and disruptors," Han Xiao said calmly.

"… Why didn't you use it earlier?" Kasuyi was helpless. If we knew that you had this technology, who would have attacked Hella?

"I only developed it not long ago."

Han Xiao nodded. Looking at Kasuyi's expression, he knew that his goal had been achieved.

He had deliberately displayed the teleportation ability of the King to let others know that he had a teleportation method that could ignore the space stabilization device. Otherwise, if Radiance and Ethereal refused to give up, they might attack Hella again in the future. Furthermore, he could not keep Hella hidden forever.

The reason he had displayed this trump card now was to let the outside world know that Hella was surrounded and could escape at any time. This would dispel Radiance and Ethereal's thoughts and prevent today's incident from happening again.

This way, Hella's situation would be much safer, and no one would have any ideas about her.

Swoosh!

At this moment, the King appeared again. The mechanical suit opened, revealing a confused Yin Ying.

"Eh, Black Star? Where is this? "

Yin Ying had a puzzled look on his face and had yet to recover from his shock.

"Let's not talk about it first. My time is limited, and I still need to borrow your body. After we're done, I'll give you the Evolution Cube."

Han Xiao patted Yin Ying's shoulder, pulled the confused Yin Ying, and turned to leave.

Seeing this, Kasuyi was surprised.

"It's over. Where are you going?"

"It's not over for me yet. While my explosive ability is still there, I still have a target to deal with."

"Who is it?" Kasuyi was curious.

Han Xiao turned around and gave Kasuyi a side profile.
